title: PJ Hughes—Witness to Confiscation of E-2 Hawkeye Electronic Tic Tac Data from USS Nimitz 2004
description:
http://SimeonHein.com
PJ, an airplane weapons/electronic technician and member of the elite "Wallbangers" unit on the USS Nimitz,  tells us how his commanding officer and two Air Force men came to his room after the Tic Tac events, within a half hour of him putting the E-2 Hawkeye "data bricks" into a secure safe, and demanded he give them the hard disks. He was also told not to talk about it.
